failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What attractions are currently located at Universal Studios Florida, and which ones have been replaced or removed?' Hop 3 query: 'What happened to the Back to the Future Ride at Universal Studios Florida, and what attraction replaced it?' Both queries ask about replacement information already established in hop 1. Hop 1 passage states 'Back to the Future: The Ride...was previously located at Universal Studios Florida...where it has since been replaced by The Simpsons Ride.' Both summary_1 and summary_2 already confirmed this replacement. Later queries re-ask for the same replacement fact without advancing verification.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 3 retrieval returned 10 documents, many irrelevant to the claim: 'What Happens in Hell, Stays in Hell' (psychobilly album), 'This Is What Happens' (band album), 'The 5th Dimension (ride)' (Chessington World of Adventures), 'ImageWorks: The What-If Labs' (Epcot attraction), 'Wonders of Life' (Epcot pavilion). These documents concern different parks or music albums unrelated to verifying whether Universal Studios Florida hosts both Back to the Future Ride and The Simpsons Ride. The solver had already established the core facts in hop 1.
